## Actual trials
Repack source GLB with decoded PNG textures, remove EXT_texture_webp requirements and original redundant WebP bytes. Set common feather material metallic=0, roughness=.9, remove metallicRoughnessTexture binding (unused PNG retained). Preserve positions, normals, indices, UVs. Rasterize 192765 actual UV triangles with mean per-vertex mask weight, protecting anterior head and feet; UV island padding nearest within 4 pixels. S(t)=clamp(t,0,1)^2*(3-2*clamp(t,0,1)); weight=(1-S((y+.005)/.13)*S((z-.18)/.13))*(1-S((-.11-y)/.095)*S((z-.17)/.14)). Local outlier = S((mean(median5 RGB)-mean(RGB)-12)/40)*mask; blend median only at local dark outliers plus mild cream tint (7,4,0)*mask, k=0,.65,1. UV raster coverage .618396; mean padded mask .837477; only 248 pixels had outlier weight >.5. No claim that face mask is pixel-perfect. Base and two variants reimported successfully, same 219071 vertices /192765 triangles.

Investigated actual topology: rounding positions at 4,5,6 decimals consistently gives 87895 unique vertices, 7 degenerate faces and 990 coincident unordered triangle duplicates; trimesh processed mesh winding consistent, reported 1232 face-split components (distinct from vertex connectivity). Removed duplicate/degenerate faces and disconnected tiny vertex-connected islands with <=3 faces, using six-decimal positional weld ONLY for diagnostic labels, retaining original UV-seamed vertices and normals in output. Largest cleaned pre-island-filter component 191448 faces. Result removed 1005 faces, reimported genuine GLB with 219071 vertices and 191760 faces. No claim of global manifoldness. 

Actual VTK/Xvfb renders: 12 images comparing three texture strengths and 8 comparing before/after topology removal; same camera center (-.225,.012,.116), parallel scale .43, angles 0/45/90/180, elevation offset .08, 300x285 pixels. Both contact sheets visually examined. Small tint change, persistent surface dark outlines/speckles; removal of coincident faces and tiny islands does not visibly resolve defects. VTK lighting is darker than original Cycles. Neither intervention corrects narrow eyes, elongated visible tail, low feet/belly silhouette, or inadequate cream down. All four rejected. No new mobile WebGL or physical phone acceptance. Do not confuse topology or import success with visual approval.
